legend: Stingy Jack and the first jack-o'-lantern (Ireland, folktale)
lines: In old Ireland, they tell of a man called Stingy Jack.
He was a clever drunk who tricked the Devil himself.
Legend says he trapped him up an apple tree, with crosses cut in the bark.
Jack only let him down after a promise: never take my soul.
But when Jack died, heaven turned him away.
And the Devil kept his promise, and refused him too.
He tossed Jack a single burning coal to light his way.
Jack set it inside a turnip, and he wanders the bogs forever.
That is why we carve lanterns. Would you follow his light?
title: The Cursed Man Behind Every Jack-o'-Lantern #shorts
description:
Irish legend says Stingy Jack tricked the Devil, then was refused by heaven and hell. Now he wanders the bogs with a burning coal in a turnip.
